Let Z be their common-zero product fiber. Any polynomial P equal to1 on Z, of reduced degree<=e, and weight w of degree<=b satisfy rank(f in V_K -> (wP g_i f)_i) >= rank(V_K -> (wf)|Z) whenever b+K+e<q*delta, in the full local function algebra, b,e,K nonnegative integers. For w=1 the rank is at least the coefficient sum through degree K of (1+(Q-1)z)^(m-qd)*(sum_(j<delta)(Q-1)^j binom(d,j)z^j)^q, hence normalized rank >=1-q*(4K/m)^delta for K<=m. Arbitrary polynomial coefficient rows beta_ui of degree<=T give P=product_(u<=h)(1+sum_i beta_ui g_i), automatically P|Z=1 and e<=h(T+delta); retain D>=b+K+h(T+delta)+delta for the actual mapped columns before local reduction. A weight killing all such local companions must vanish on Z if b+e<q*delta. No charged-quotient floor or obstruction to optimized incoming weights is asserted; original complete-source replay retains its own b+K+TB budget.
